title: The Trump Administration Defangs the Endangered Species Act
body_text:
In its second term, the Trump administration has increased its efforts to undo environmental regulations. Last week, it became clear that the Endangered Species Act, one of America’s bedrock environmental laws, would be losing some of its most important protections.
Catrin Einhorn, who covers biodiversity, explains what is changing and what impact that could have on the country’s most vulnerable animals and ecosystems. 
Guest: Catrin Einhorn, a reporter covering biodiversity, climate and the environment for The New York Times.
Background reading: 

The Trump administration moved to gut a core protection of the Endangered Species Act last week.
